recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to the extension definition belong in the FHIR Extension Pack, and future changes to the core ValueSet explanation should wait for a new Vocab decision.
issue_request: FHIR-18710 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request asking FHIR core to add support for a Value Set Definition non-computable content expression; the resolution was to add an extension.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249 applied terminology ballot updates in core ValueSet extension material, including the ValueSet expression extension row that initially carried the alternative expression concept.
additional_context: Later Vocab/VSDP work split the mechanism into computable valueset-expression and non-computable valueset-rules-text. Current core no longer contains the extension StructureDefinition sources, but the active ValueSet page links to the extension artifacts and the FHIR Extension Pack contains the authoritative valueset-rules-text definition. FHIR-31489 further clarified that valueset-expression should point users to rules-text for non-computable definitions.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current core ValueSet narrative already identifies valueset-rules-text as the human-interpreted, non-computable mechanism, source/oids.ini preserves canonical identifiers, and the extension definition exists in the Extension Pack.

related_jiras.note: Clarified valueset-expression wording and explicitly directed non-computable value set definitions to valueset-rules-text.
Later no-change discussion about valueset-expression language binding; it does not require a FHIR-18710 source change.
Later CRMI ComputableValueSet issue about rulesText/profile behavior outside FHIR core; not decided here.
